title: Edit Member URL Dashboard Internal Pages | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Edit Member URL Dashboard Internal Pages Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000100652 This documentation explains how to edit all URLs within the member dashboard area through the Advanced Settings section: /account /home /contact /profile /resume /about /locations /leads /promote/verify /changelisting /billing /password /upgrade Member Dashboard URL: Home The portion URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is on their Member Dashboard Home Page. Member Dashboard URL: Contact Details Form A portion of the URL used when a member fills out the "Contact Details" form in the Member Dashboard. Member Dashboard URL: Profile Photo A portion of the URL used when a member uploads their Profile Photo, Logo, and/or Cover Photo in the Member Dashboard. Member Dashboard URL: Listing Details Form A portion of the URL used when a member fills out the "Listing Details" form in the Member Dashboard. Member Dashboard URL: About Form A portion of the URL used when a member fills out the "About" form in the Member Dashboard. Member Dashboard URL: Service Areas A portion of the URL used when a member selects Service Areas in the Member Dashboard. Member Dashboard URL: Account The root URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is logged in to their account. By default this URL is /account/. Member Dashboard URL: Leads Page The portion of the URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is viewing their Leads page in their Account. By default this URL is leads. Member Dashboard URL: Verify Listing Portion of the URL that will display when a member is verifying their account in the Member Dashboard. By default is promote/verify. Member Dashboard URL: Upgrade Portion of the URL that will display when a member is upgrading their account in the Member Dashboard. By default is /upgrade. Member Dashboard URL: Changelisting Portion of the URL that will display when a member clicks on the Manage Account link in the Member Dashboard. By default is /changelisting. Member Dashboard URL: Password Portion of the URL that will display when a member wants to modify their password in their account on the Member Dashboard. By default, it is /password. Member Dashboard URL: Billing Portion of the URL that will display when a member visits the Billing Information section of their account on the Member Dashboard. By default, it is /billing. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
